title: Wanted Suspect Attempts to Flee from Sandy Springs Police
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Sandy Springs, Georgia — On April 28, 2025, a Sandy Springs Police Department Traffic Unit officer was conducting speed enforcement along State Route 400 when a Jeep Wagoneer was observed traveling at 99 MPH in a 65 MPH zone. The vehicle was also observed recklessly passing other motorists. When the officer initiated a traffic stop, the driver, who was later identified as Demario Grooms, chose to flee, which escalated the situation. A pursuit ensued, during which Grooms drove in an emergency lane and disregarded traffic control devices. Ultimately, Grooms was apprehended and arrested without further incident.

He is facing multiple charges, including:    
•  Speeding (99 in a 65)    
•  Reckless Driving    
•  Felony Fleeing and Eluding    
•  Driving in an Emergency Lane    
•  Failure to Obey a Traffic Control Device    
•  Driving while License Suspended
